title: AI in Support of Diversity and Inclusion

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating machine translation outputs for stereotyped gender assignments when translating from gender-neutral languages (e.g., Hungarian to English) and developing rule-based rewriters for gender-neutral forms.

Quantifying explicit and implicit bias in structured pattern classification datasets using fuzzy-rough sets and recurrent neural networks to explore connections between protected and unprotected features.

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and Gender Identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Automated, large-scale monitoring of search engine interactions (over 178k queries across 8 countries) to analyze the propagation and platform prioritization of anti-LGBTQ+ disinformation narratives.

Automatic visual content analysis using Deep Learning to evaluate the portrayal of migrants, refugees, and expats in media images across ten countries, comparing portrayed demographics against official statistics.
Evaluating communication gaps and exclusion of deaf and hard-of-hearing individuals by developing inclusive machine translation frameworks and specialized corpora for sign and spoken languages.
